comment: Z-index scale — layering order for all positioned elements. Values form a strict ascending stack; never skip a level without a documented reason.

nav.comment: Sticky top and bottom navigation bars.

drawer.comment: Side drawer sheet — one above nav so it covers the navigation bar when open.

overlay.comment: Tooltips and floating overlay labels (e.g. circular-progress center text).

toast.comment: Toast notifications — topmost layer, must appear above all other UI.
